verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official CLI for deploying from the terminal (railway-docs-15, railway-probe-3) and one-command setup of CLI authentication for agents (railway-docs-19). An MCP server also lets AI assistants create projects, manage environments and redeploy programmatically (railway-docs-20), and repo-connected deploys with per-PR previews give git-driven automation (railway-docs-1, railway-docs-12). The evidence never explicitly covers non-interactive or CI usage, and no OpenAPI spec was found (railway-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented CI/headless auth (project or API tokens for pipelines), explicit CI integration guides such as GitHub Actions, a public API spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
